name: Love Hate Love
aliases: Love Hate Love Alice in Chains Tribute

evidence.note: Oct 3 at The Warehouse, Amityville: an unplugged night with Serve The Servants, Love Hate Love and Unglued.
Organizers describe the acoustic grunge night as intimate and not a typical loud tribute show.
Full-band 21+ tribute show at Spotlight at The Paramount, Huntington.

dancing.notes: A grunge tribute. The Oct 3 Warehouse show is an acoustic 'unplugged' night meant for close listening, not dancing.

description: A Long Island tribute band that plays the songs of 90s grunge band Alice in Chains, sometimes in an acoustic 'unplugged' format.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Facebook page lists Farmingdale, NY as home base.

Directory research 2026-10-04: No official website found; the Facebook page is the band's main presence (confirmed by its page title and Long Island show posts in search results; could not open it without logging in). An Instagram handle "lovehatelovetribute" was suggested by one search summary but could not be confirmed, so it is not recorded. No logo or photos taken because the only official images are on Facebook (login needed). Current description is still accurate.

evidence.note: Spotlight @ The Paramount (Huntington) event page: Love Hate Love is a Long Island based Alice in Chains tribute covering all eras of the band (Nov 23, 2024 show with Damage Inc.).
Search-indexed post on the "Love Hate Love Alice in Chains Tribute band" Facebook page announcing a western Suffolk County show, matching the current Facebook URL.
